items.text: Bears are planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after he missed the past three games with torn hamstring but completed a full week of practice without setbacks; listed questionable but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week, no setbacks; sources confirm starter plan.
items.implication: Bears offense upgrades; boosts Rome Odunze, Colston Loveland, D'Andre Swift usage.
items.opportunity: High implied total vs ATL pass D; stack potential.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to a blood clot in his calf after consultations with doctors; he is out for the foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Superficial blood clot requiring treatment; cannot play on blood thinners.
items.implication: Hurts sidelined indefinitely (min ~6 weeks possible); McKee starts vs CAR with limited rushing upside.
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume potential for DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks if McKee airs it out.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR to the 53-man roster; he is expected to play Sunday vs Jets after returning to practice this week from high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Completed 21-day practice window; limited practice earlier in week but cleared.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 upside in NE offense vs NYJ; start if rostered.
items.opportunity: High target share expected on return; monitors snap count for rust.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled out for Week 6 vs CAR with hamstring; unable to practice all week. With backups on IR, Dameon Pierce expected for sizable workload behind compromised line and McKee.
items.implication: Pierce lead back but limited upside in McKee offense; fade Eagles RBs overall.
items.opportunity: Pierce handcuff elevation; goal-line/third-down shares available.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from Injured Reserve; he is expected to play Sunday versus the Browns.
items.why: Cleared from IR after practice; wrist injury resolved.
items.implication: Depth addition with Lamar out; potential target share in Huntley offense.
items.opportunity: Watch for snaps behind Flowers/Andrews; deep league stash.

items.text: Please pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing a QB if available. He will be better than expected; not worried about Eagles skill players with him under center despite limited prior reps in Mannion O.
items.why: Hurts IR opens multi-week start; McKee can play and protect skill talent.
items.implication: Streamable QB with DeVonta/Goedert upside intact.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT another week with ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts vs Browns. Zay Flowers remains WR2 viable.
items.why: Ankle; DNP practices, ruled out Friday.
items.implication: Huntley caps rushing/passing ceiling; Flowers still startable, Andrews downgraded.
items.opportunity: Flowers target share stable; monitor Huntley checkdowns.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown is active for the Patriots he'll be active for me. Starting him as a WR2 wherever I got him.
items.why: Activation confirmed; talent overrides potential rust vs Jets.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans vs Jaguars in London; Woody Marks or others elevate in backfield with Dell also out.
items.implication: Texans RB committee shift; Marks potential lead but low ceiling vs JAX.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Jets vs Patriots; secondary backs see expanded roles in limited offense.
items.implication: Jets RB committee; fade overall without Hall volume.

items.text: Cheap WR Volume for Week 6 live: WRs under $5k DK/$6k FD projected for 5+ targets; includes volume plays amid injury chaos like Odunze with Caleb return.
items.why: Projected targets in value range; Caleb boosts CHI pass catchers.
items.implication: DFS/cash value; broader volume indicators for Odunze etc.
items.opportunity: 5+ target floors for listed cheap WRs.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers; strong matchup and role.
items.why: WSH secondary nightmare; Evans usage bankable.
items.implication: Elite WR1/2 start in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share vs weak D.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) with bankable usage in solid matchup.
items.why: Usage you can bank on; CHI defense allows opportunities.

items.text: Loves George Kittle vs WSH (TE3); Commanders D nightmare for TEs.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite recent usage vs run-leaking defense.
items.why: Volume elite; ARI leaks vs run.

items.text: Loves Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8); volume plus goal-line role vs leaky run D.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28); ugly matchup and shaky QB situation.
items.why: Seattle tough on WRs; QB issues.

items.text: Hates Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34); struggled for targets lately in tough spot.
